items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I was wondering about this guy, uh, Tato... would you say that he played anything like Willie Cornish and Frankie Deucon? ... [INTERVIEWEE] When they played valve? That's right. Of the same order.

ctx.x: I'll put that fan in here. No, no, this is fine.

I'm plenty cool. Uh, now I was wondering about this guy, uh, Tato, you know, I'm not going to play, and, uh, I'd say, would you say that he played anything like Willie Cornish and Frankie Deucon? Yeah.
When they played valve? That's right. Of the same order. Jupiter, T, and that bunch, that's all was valve players too. Ambrose. Those men played valve.
